items.material:
Visitor: Does every family celebrate in the same way?
Guide: No. Traditions vary by place and family, and they change over time. In my family we cook together, but my cousin prefers visiting older relatives.
Visitor: I will describe these as examples rather than rules for everyone.

NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Host: Our neighbourhood paper-star evening begins at seven. The craft tables open at a quarter past five. Children must come with an adult. Use battery lights in the paper stars; candles are not permitted here. If it rains, we will tell stories indoors.
Guide: In my family, we walk by the river. My cousin prefers making masks at home. Family activities vary and can change over time.
Visitor: I will describe those activities as examples, not rules for every family.
